blocks.label: Cultural Tip
blocks.title: Colombian “onces”
blocks.text: In the middle of the afternoon, many Colombians have “onces”: coffee with pandebono, almojábana or buñuelo. At “onces” you still say Good afternoon. Good evening starts when the sun goes down, around six o'clock.
